edge_cost: mean(endpoint node costs) + cliff_weight*(actual height difference)^2
endpoint_selection: start nearest centroid of M low/gentle Y<=90; destinations nearest centroids of E Y>=180 in predeclared north/central/south Z bands; research probes, not settlement sites
graph: 4-neighbor dry columns of east island only; water excluded; no diagonal corner cutting
limitations: finite cliff penalty permits jumps; cost paths are not confirmed walkable routes, roads or trade routes
